events.description: Display of the initial 'Differential Equation' term and its transition to 'Transformed Equation' via the Laplace transform arrow.
events.clip_query: The text 'Differential Equation' transforms into 'Transformed Equation' with a downward arrow labeled with the Laplace symbol.

events.description: Transition from 'Transformed Equation' to 'Transformed Solution' via the algebraic solve arrow.
events.clip_query: An arrow pointing right labeled 'Solve Algebraically' appears, transforming the text to 'Transformed Solution'.

events.description: Transition from 'Transformed Solution' back to 'Solution' via the Inverse Laplace arrow.
events.clip_query: An upward arrow labeled with the inverse Laplace symbol appears, transforming the text to 'Solution'.

events.description: Creation of the split-screen Time domain and s domain background rectangles with labels.
events.clip_query: Two horizontal domain boxes fade in, labeling the top half 'Time domain' and the bottom half 's domain'.
